# Kadena Nexus

> Kadena Nexus is an independent, community-run project that builds tools for Kadena Community Edition (KCE), the Kadena proof-of-work blockchain as it runs today. It is based in Saudi Arabia, has been building since January 2026, and is not affiliated with Kadena LLC. It works alongside the kda-community developers and the community DAO, building tools that support Kadena Community Edition and collaborating with them on new projects. Each product runs on its own kadena.ws subdomain and reads directly from Chainweb. Nothing on these sites is financial advice.

Kadena Community Edition is the same Kadena chain and the same KDA coin, continued by former Kadena engineers and community developers after Kadena LLC announced on October 21, 2025 that it was ceasing operations. The community release (chainweb-node 3.0) took over at block 6,335,858 on November 8, 2025. Balances, accounts and Pact contracts carried over unchanged. Since release 3.1, network upgrades are activated by miner vote.

Kadena Nexus also runs a Kadena mainnet node in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia (public API at node.kadena.ws).

## Explainers

- [What is Kadena Community Edition?](https://kadena.ws/community-edition/): what happened in 2025, what changed and what did not, and what it means for KDA holders
- [How to buy KDA in 2026](https://kadena.ws/buy-kda/): exchanges that still list KDA (Gate.io, AnonKyc, per kda-chain.org), the USDC bridge route via Kinesis to kb-USDC, the Mercatus DEX, person-to-person escrow and earning KDA; Gate.io's own KDA status (trading, deposits, withdrawals) is checked every morning
- [How to mine Kadena (KDA) in 2026](https://kadena.ws/mining/): Blake2s ASICs (Antminer KA3, about 166 TH/s), pools and each mining account's share of the last hour of blocks counted on chain, pool fees and payout methods, solo mining with Kadena Garden, miner setup, and what one KA3 earns per day; network numbers refreshed daily
- [Kadena wallets in 2026](https://kadena.ws/wallets/): self-custody wallets listed by kda-chain.org (Linx Wallet, eckoWALLET, Zelcore, Chainweaver; list checked daily), which to pick, k: accounts on 20 chains, gas, WalletConnect and safety
- [Partner with Kadena Nexus](https://kadena.ws/partnership/): what Kadena Nexus looks for in partners who bring users, liquidity and market making, or advertising to Kadena; paid campaigns, revenue share or both; how to send a proposal
- [Kadena AgentPay AI](https://kadena.ws/agentpay/): AI agents pay for data and compute in KDA over x402, within spending limits the owner sets and a Pact contract enforces; in development, with test results from the Nexus devnet (first test purchase November 17, 2026) and a test against the official x402 JavaScript libraries
- [Kadena games and NFTs in 2026](https://kadena.ws/games/): Kadena Nexus Games (win KDA for puzzles), game and NFT projects listed by kda-chain.org (checked daily), the Marmalade NFT standard and building games on Kadena
- [Kadena RPC endpoints and public nodes](https://kadena.ws/rpc/): mainnet network ID mainnet01, Pact API per chain at api.chainweb-community.org, the cut and info endpoints, the chaddex GraphQL indexer, the Saudi node node.kadena.ws (info and cut, CORS open), and a tested @kadena/client example
- [Kadena FAQ](https://kadena.ws/faq/): block time (30 seconds per chain), 20 chains, 1 billion max supply, mining, quantum safety, wallets; current exchanges, wallets, node release and network numbers refreshed daily
- [KDA tokenomics after the fork](https://kadena.ws/tokenomics/): KDA supply read from mainnet daily – 990 million created by the protocol (700 million mining over ~120 years, 290 million genesis allocations), mined and claimed so far, and the 87,344,000 KDA platform share that was never claimed and has been frozen since block 6,332,978 (November 6, 2025) under a community 3-of-5 multisig (Edmund Noble, Jose Cardona, Louis Page, Pascal Sclafer, Tadeas Kmenta). It sits in the coin contract allocation table as entries PS_C0_… to PS_C9_… on chains 0–9
- [Nexus Research](https://kadena.ws/research/): the index of Kadena Nexus experiments and findings on Kadena – numbered studies (NR-001 is the November 2026 mainnet stress test), planned studies on block gas limit, chain count, latency and mining distribution, and the live data sets (network reports, tokenomics, Adoption Index, Network Monitor, Quantum-Safe Kadena), each with method, limits and data checkable on chain
- [Transfer fees today](https://kadena.ws/research/fees/): the US dollar cost of one simple transfer on Kadena, Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain, Polygon, Solana, Tron, Bitcoin, Stellar and the XRP Ledger, measured daily from public data, with method and limits; JSON and daily CSV
- [Kadena mainnet stress test: 1,000 TPS in, 408 TPS processed](https://kadena.ws/tps/): Kadena Nexus test of mainnet throughput on Nov 14, 2026, from one test account at the minimum fee, in six tests from 5 to 1,000 TPS. Kadena accepted 1,000 transactions per second for 3 minutes and processed all 179,700 accepted transactions, all successful, with zero downtime. Busiest height 408 TPS (all 20 chains full at once, 12,240 transactions), 226 TPS over 100 blocks. About 38 times Bitcoin's busiest day, 60 times Litecoin's, 29 times Dogecoin's and 17 times Bitcoin Cash's. Today's limit is block space (612 transfers per block per chain at the default gas limit); bigger blocks, more chains or faster blocks would raise it.
- [Kadena network reports](https://kadena.ws/reports/): one original report per month on Kadena mainnet (from October 2026), updated every week from public chain data – daily transactions (with the automated free.block-history recorder, which ran until October 12, 2026, counted separately), blocks and mining hashrate on all 20 chains, transactions per chain, public nodes by country and method notes. All daily data since September 15, 2026 is free to download at https://kadena.ws/reports/data/kadena-daily.csv
- [Kadena news](https://kadena.ws/news/): weekly Kadena Community Edition news, with node releases, core development from kda-community on GitHub, network numbers (24h transactions, block time, active chains, Adoption Index score) and new Kadena Nexus tools. Rebuilt every day
- [Quantum-Safe Kadena](https://quantum.kadena.ws/): how Kadena's post-quantum accounts (SLH-DSA / SPHINCS+ q: accounts) will work, with a progress bar toward production that updates itself from the core developers' public work

## Live products

- [Kadeway](https://buy.kadena.ws/): buy and sell KDA with USDC from Ethereum in one guided flow: Kinesis bridge (USDC to kb-USDC on Chain 2) and a Mercatus swap. Users connect MetaMask and eckoWALLET or Linx and sign every step in their own wallets; Kadeway never holds funds. Beta: 1 to 100 USDC per transfer, desktop browsers.
- [Kadena Garden](https://mine.kadena.ws/): open-source solo mining through shared nodes. Every block a miner's rigs find pays straight to their own wallet, with Direct, Sweep or Convert payouts and 0% fee on Direct and Sweep (0.5% on Convert, paid as hashrate). Pool address stratum+tcp://mine.kadena.ws:1917. A collaboration with Pascal (@CryptoPascal31).
- [KadenaTrace](https://trace.kadena.ws/): free tracer for stolen crypto on 11 networks (Ethereum, TRON, Bitcoin, Solana, BNB Chain, Arbitrum, Base, Polygon, Optimism, Avalanche, Kadena). Follows the funds through swaps and bridges to exchanges, shows a live feed of hacks and exchange-outflow early warnings, and records every case and every move of the funds on Kadena in the free.kadena-trace Pact contract (Chain 1). Early warnings are also written to Kadena as they fire. Alerts on X at @KadenaTrace.
- [Kadena P2P Marketplace](https://marketplace.kadena.ws/): buy and sell KDA person to person. The seller's KDA is held in the Pact escrow contract free.p2p-escrow-v11 (Chains 1 and 2) until the trade completes. Pay in USDT or USDC and the KDA is released automatically when the exact payment arrives; pay in kb-USDC, kb-ETH, kb-USDT, BRO or FLUX and the swap settles instantly in one transaction. Disputes go to an arbiter. Opens in Linx Wallet. No sign-up and no platform fee, only network gas.
- [Kadena Network Monitor](https://nodes.kadena.ws/): live view of Kadena mainnet, with every block on all 20 chains, throughput, confirmation times and a map of public nodes. Free.
- [Kadena Community Edition Adoption Index](https://adoption.kadena.ws/): one number, updated daily at 00:00 UTC, measuring whether KCE is used more or less than its summer 2026 baseline of 50. Built from active addresses, new contracts, TVL, hashrate and GitHub commits. Methodology: https://adoption.kadena.ws/methodology
- [Kadena Whale Watch](https://kadena.ws/whales/): every move of 100,000 KDA or more on all 20 chains, live – wallet moves, exchange deposits and withdrawals (wallets labelled "confirmed" or "likely" with sources), big DEX trades, pool liquidity changes and any movement of the frozen 87,344,000 KDA platform share. Alerts post automatically to X at @KDAWhaleWatch. Free.
- [Kadena Earn](https://earn.kadena.ws/): get paid in KDA for useful work for Kadena, such as testing apps, reporting bugs and explaining what is new. Every task is funded in escrow before it goes live, and every payout links to its transaction on Chainweb.
- [Kadena Devs](https://kadenadevs.kadena.ws/): the projects built by the Kadena Nexus dev team, what is live and what is in development, and how developers can join.

## In development

- ChainProof (chainproof.kadena.ws): QR-based proof of authenticity for physical goods, recorded on Kadena.
- Kadena AgentPay AI (https://kadena.ws/agentpay/, later agentpay.kadena.ws): lets AI agents pay for data and compute in KDA over x402, with owner-set limits enforced by a Pact contract. Running on the Nexus devnet.
- Kadena Privacy (privacy.kadena.ws): zero-knowledge privacy tools in Pact, starting with Prove (show you hold at least a given amount of KDA without revealing your wallet).
